# *BenQ RD280UG* — 28.2" 4K+ 120Hz Programming Monitor

**Category:** Monitor

**MSRP:** $759.99

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Screen Size | 28.2" |
| Panel Type | IPS, LED backlight, Nano Matte coating |
| Resolution (max) | 3840 x 2560 (3:2 aspect ratio) |
| Brightness | 350 nits typical, 400 nits peak (HDR) |
| HDR | HDR10, VESA DisplayHDR 400 |
| Refresh Rate | 120 Hz |
| Response Time (GtG) | 5 ms |
| Native Contrast | 2000:1 |
| Color Gamut | 95% P3 |
| Display Colors | 1.07 billion |
| Viewing Angle (L/R) | 178°/178° |
| PPI | 164 |
| Color Modes | Coding – Paper Color, Coding – Dark Theme, Coding – Light Theme, sRGB, HDR, M-book, User, Game, ePaper, Cinema |
| Ports | 1x HDMI 2.1, 1x DisplayPort 1.4, 1x USB-C (90W PD, DP Alt Mode, Data), 1x USB-B upstream (USB 3.2 Gen 1), 2x USB-A downstream (USB 3.2 Gen 2, 4.5W), 1x USB-C downstream (10Gbps, 15W), 1x USB-C downstream (10Gbps, 7.5W), headphone jack |
| Daisy Chain | USB-C out (MST) |
| Built-in Speakers | 3W x 2 |
| Ergonomics | Tilt -5°/20°, swivel 15°/15°, pivot 90°, height adjust 150mm |
| Dimensions (landscape, HxWxD) | 24.2" x 24.0" x 9.2" (615.2 x 610.4 x 233.3 mm) |
| Net Weight | 22.2 lb (10.1 kg); 17.1 lb (7.8 kg) without base |
| VESA Mount | 100x100 mm |
| Power Consumption | 30W normal, 250W max, <0.5W sleep |
| KVM Switch | Yes |
| Eye Care | Flicker-free, Low Blue Light, Night Hours Protection, Visual Optimizer, Color Weakness mode, ePaper mode, Eye Reminder |
| Certifications | Energy Star 8.0, EPEAT Bronze, TÜV Eye Comfort 2.0/EyeSafe 2.0/Flicker-free/Low Blue Light/Reflection Free |
| Gaming | AMD FreeSync Premium |
| Software | Display Pilot 2, Display Quickit |

## Notable Features

- Rare 3:2 aspect ratio gives more vertical workspace for reading and scrolling through code than a standard 16:9 4K monitor
- Nano Matte anti-glare panel designed specifically to reduce reflections during long coding sessions
- MoonHalo ambient bias backlight with auto-dimming for day-to-night eye comfort
- Dedicated Coding Modes (Dark Theme, Light Theme, Paper Color) tuned for code differentiation, plus a physical Coding HotKey on the function bar
- Built-in KVM switch lets one keyboard/mouse control two connected computers
- 90W USB-C power delivery with DisplayPort Alt Mode and USB-C daisy chain (MST) support for multi-monitor setups
- ±90° pivot with auto-pivot detection for portrait/landscape orientation switching
- Display Pilot 2 software is cross-platform (macOS, Windows, Linux)
